title: Chicken with Mushrooms, Prosciutto, and Cream Sauce
description: Try this recipe for chicken and mushrooms in cream sauce for a dinner party or a special family meal. It's quick, simple, and delicious.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Drizzle butter into a casserole dish. Season chicken with 1 tablespoon garlic, salt, and pepper. Wrap each thigh in a prosciutto slice and place into a casserole dish. Sprinkle mushrooms and remaining garlic over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until the juices run clear, about 1 hour. Remove from the oven, transfer chicken and mushrooms to a platter, and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
Pour drippings from the baking dish into a skillet set over medium-low heat. Whisk in sour cream and wine; cook sauce until heated through, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Pour sauce over chicken and mushrooms to serve.

video.description: This chicken is simple, delicious, and has an elegant presentation! If you don't have prosciutto on hand, you can use bacon. Make it extra special by throwing in a variety of exotic mushrooms like shiitake, portabella, or oyster. It can be prepped ahead of time and thrown in the oven when ready. Serve with garlic mashed potatoes, buttered noodles or basmati rice.
